content: {"piece_id":"02","question":"How strong is the current evidence that AI coding agents improve developer productivity, and what methodological gaps should student developers watch for when evaluating those claims?","argument":"Published benchmarks and vendor demonstrations offer some structured evidence, but the methods behind productivity claims vary widely and several important perspectives—including small-team failures and maintainability costs—appear largely absent from the available record.","source_refs":["source-7","source-25","source-22","source-20"]}
